teaser/T02.setting: An office, with the dealer sitting at a desk.

timeline.action: The man sits at his desk, leaning his head on his right hand with his eyes closed. His body is completely still. His expression is one of stress and exhaustion.

calm_windows.what: The entire shot is a static, natural pose. The man's stressed posture is clearly motivated by the large stack of paperwork on his desk.

fits_lines.beat: T02 (2.1s from the clip's start): "और सुबह इंस्पेक्शन है।"
fits_lines.why: The line about an impending inspection perfectly explains the dealer's stressed and overwhelmed posture in front of a large pile of paperwork.

teaser/T05.setting: A man is squatting at a petrol pump, checking the fuel level in an underground tank with a dipstick.

timeline.action: In a squatting position, he uses both hands to slowly pull a long measuring dipstick out of an open manhole. His head is tilted down, and his eyes follow the stick as it rises.
He holds the dipstick still. His head turns slightly to his right and then back to the center, his eyes scanning the markings on the stick. His brow is slightly furrowed in concentration.

teaser/T05.camera: Static medium shot, eye-level with the squatting man.

calm_windows.what: The entire shot consists of a single, coherent action: the man is measuring the fuel in a tank. All his movements are focused on and motivated by this task.

fits_lines.why: The line asks if there is less or more fuel in the tank. The man's action of pulling out a dipstick and carefully reading it is a direct and perfect visualization of this question.

teaser/T03.setting: An office, seen through a glass partition. The man stands behind a counter, holding a large ledger book.

timeline.action: The man is looking down at a large, open ledger book. His head is tilted down and his eyes are on the pages. Both hands are on the book, holding it open.
He lifts his head and eyes to look forward at the person in the foreground. His expression becomes stern and questioning. His hands remain resting on the open book.

teaser/T03.camera: Static medium shot, filmed from over the shoulder of a person in the foreground.

calm_windows.what: The entire shot consists of a single, motivated action: the man looks up from a ledger to confront the person in front of him.

fits_lines.beat: T03 (2.0s from the clip's start): "आज डी-एस-आर किसने लिखा?"
fits_lines.why: The action perfectly matches the line. The man is looking at a ledger (which could be the DSR, or Daily Sales Report) and then looks up with a stern, questioning expression, as if he is the one asking the question.

teaser/T01.setting: A petrol pump at night. A large white tanker truck is parked under the brightly lit canopy. Two men are standing in front of it.

timeline.action: The dealer (man on the left) and another man stand completely motionless, like figures in a photograph. The dealer's hands are by his sides, and he looks forward towards the camera.

problems.what: The entire scene is completely static, like a photograph. The two men show no signs of life or natural movement (like breathing or slight shifts in posture), which is unnatural for a video clip.

fits_lines.beat: T01 (2.3s from the clip's start): "रात के दो बजे भी पंप जागता है।"
fits_lines.why: The visual setting of a lit petrol pump at night with a tanker present fits the line about the pump being 'awake'. However, the complete, unnatural stillness of the men contradicts the idea of activity or being 'awake'.

teaser/T06.setting: An office, with the man standing at a wooden counter next to a large window, looking at a notebook.

timeline.action: The man stands leaning over an open spiral notebook. His head is tilted down, looking at the pages. His left hand is on the left page, and his right hand is holding the edge of the right-hand page, as if he has just turned it.
His right hand moves from the edge of the page to press it flat onto the counter. His left hand also adjusts slightly on its page.
Using his right hand, he closes the notebook. His left hand moves to rest on the now-closed cover. His head remains looking down at the book.

teaser/T06.camera: The camera is static in a medium shot, showing the man from his side profile.

calm_windows.what: The entire shot is calm. The man is focused on the single, continuous action of looking at a notebook and then closing it. All movements are motivated and natural.

fits_lines.beat: T06 (2.6s from the clip's start): "टैंकर की डेंसिटी आज किसने देखी?"
fits_lines.why: The line is a question about checking a log ('Who checked the tanker's density today?'). The man's action of looking intently at a logbook and then closing it perfectly visualizes the act of checking or contemplating this very question.

teaser/T08.setting: The forecourt of a petrol pump during the day. A pump and a small office building are visible in the background.

timeline.action: The man holds a phone to his right ear with his right hand and keeps his left hand in his left trouser pocket. He looks towards the camera with a serious expression. He takes a slow, deliberate step forward with his right foot, then begins to bring his left foot forward, walking slowly towards the camera.

calm_windows.what: The entire shot consists of a single, continuous, and motivated action: a man walking while on a serious phone call.

fits_lines.why: The narrator asks a question about a business problem ('why has the load stopped?'). The dealer's serious expression while on the phone and walking with purpose perfectly visualizes him being actively engaged in solving that very problem.

teaser/T10.setting: A petrol pump forecourt, likely at dawn or dusk.

timeline.action: The man stands still in a full shot, hands in his trouser pockets. His body is angled slightly to his right, and he looks off-camera in the same direction with a neutral, pensive expression. His mouth is closed.
His head makes small, scanning movements. He looks slightly further to his right, then turns his head to look towards his left (camera right), then back towards his initial rightward gaze.
He turns his head more decisively to his left (camera right) and holds his gaze, as if looking at something specific just off-screen. His body remains still.

teaser/T10.camera: A static, full-length shot with a very slow, subtle push-in (digital zoom).

calm_windows.what: The entire shot is calm. The dealer stands observing his surroundings. His head movements are consistent with someone surveying their environment and do not appear random or nonsensical.

fits_lines.beat: T10 (4.1s from the clip's start): "एम-डी-जी सर्विसेज़। डीलर कवच प्रोग्राम।"
fits_lines.why: The narrator line is timed to start at 4.1 seconds, which is after this 3.9-second clip has finished playing. The action and the line do not overlap.

teaser/T09.setting: A man, presumably a petrol pump dealer, stands in a brightly lit doorway at night, looking out at his petrol pump which is visible but out of focus in the background.

timeline.action: Starts with his left hand on the back of his neck, looking up and to his right with a pensive expression. He slowly lowers his left hand to his side.
He holds a still pose, hands at his sides (right hand holding a phone), looking up and to the right.
He turns his head slowly to his left, shifting his gaze from off-screen right to looking straight ahead into the petrol pump forecourt.
While looking ahead, he slightly raises his right hand (holding the phone) and then lowers it again in a small, fidgety gesture.
He turns his head back to the right, returning to his original line of sight (looking up and right).
He raises his left hand and briefly strokes his chin once.
He lowers his left hand back to his side and holds the pose, looking up and to the right.

teaser/T09.camera: Static medium shot, with the subject framed from the waist up.

problems.what: The sequence of turning his head forward, fidgeting with the phone, and then turning his head back feels unmotivated and circular. It doesn't read as a person naturally scanning their environment, but more like a programmed set of movements.

calm_windows.what: His initial pose, the lowering of his hand, and the slow head turn to scan the area all read as natural, contemplative actions.
The chin stroke is a classic gesture of thoughtfulness and reads as perfectly natural in this context.

fits_lines.beat: T09 (1.5s from the clip's start): "पूछें किससे?"
fits_lines.why: At 1.5s, the dealer is holding a still, pensive pose, looking out into the distance. His expression and posture convey a sense of worry and uncertainty, which perfectly matches the question 'Who to ask?'.

teaser/T11.setting: A petrol pump at night. The man is standing on a step outside a glass-walled office, under an awning.
